notes.title: Typed'82 TTS Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The text to speech update is out! It took me a bit longer than expected. The sound of the first iteration was close to a robot and not too natural. So I’ve researched a bit and used an engine with a neural model to produce the words and sentences. However, I did not find a perfect way to slow down the voice for longer sentences. But I continue to test out more ideas. So, the text to speech mode works better in the Words-Mode rather than in Sentence-Mode. All three languages are supported. American English, German and a Spanish American version so far. It’s not a super easy feature to support, even on slower systems. Let me know how it feels and works for you folks.

Also, several more minor fixes made it into the update too. Mostly spelling issues and broken commands.

So, what’s next? I’m regularly changing keyboards. It’s fun sometimes to go with a particular feel, layout or anything in between, I guess. Every time I’m switching to another keyboard, my stats get messed up during the learning phase. Nothing super wild, but it’s hard to track progress with that. So one feature I’m thinking about is keyboard-based statistics like profiles for different keyboards. Typed’82 would save your keyboard profile with the run, and you can compare the stats between the keyboard profiles later on. A lot of words for a simple profile based statistics feature, I know. However, let me know if that’s interesting and what would you like to see there? Maybe something different?

In the meantime, stay safe and take care of yourselves!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks! I hope you are all doing well!

So I want to share an early development update of a new feature for TYPED'82. It's basically a dictate function that will read the words loud out for you. It works well with the Words mode and can keep up with faster typing speeds. However, the Sentence mode is a whole different story. It will read the full sentence for you, but it is fast and not easy to keep up with. The challenge is to have the dictate speed follow more or less the typing speed. At the moment, there is a basic pitch slider to slow down, but I'm still working out a more intuitive way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/94b637e3f9353f0434de235001afedd1c036d3f2.png[/img]

An early access version of the feature should come to the beta channel in the next few days if everything goes to plan. There is still a bit of testing to be done.

[previewyoutube=ZmTCfNtdcNM;full][/previewyoutube]

Until then - stay safe! <3

notes.title: Typed 82 - Update notes May 2nd
notes.notes:
[h1]Coding[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/7486785c47806282a6d03ea8228f4ad48fa85e29.png[/img]

This mode lets you practice source code in various programming languages or even your source code files if you like. The evaluation starts with your first keystroke and ends with the last. By default, the auto-indent function is active. This function will add tab/space characters at the beginning of an indented line of code. You can disable the feature via the sidebar menu. In general, this mode will help you practice writing with many special characters, like brackets, punctuation and other programming related operants. Place your source code files in "%userprofile%/Appdata/LocalLow/Beardman Studios/Typed 82/CustomCode". Extend the file names with ".txt" (like my_code.c.txt). The mode will select a random file from the directory every time.

[h1]Visual Style[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/8abef2459219aaede85fcd59c8c2fade37cab8e1.png[/img]

The visual style options got an overhaul in the settings menu for better accessibility and allowed more background styles. One of the new styles is based on a particular 90ies movie, with its falling characters in the background. I can recommend a green colour for that option. :)

[h1]Practice Settings[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/db7cb7a89c67b3ff8c973dd1711f676506b9ebb4.png[/img]

The practice mode got a few settings to mess around with. You can enable special characters like brackets and punctuation for more advanced typing practice. In addition to the new character set, there is also an option to slow down the speed.

[h1]UI Tweaks[/h1]

All those new options and modes also come with a bit of design dept. The vision of TYPED'82 is to have a clutter-free interface. So you can hide the bottom menu bar with the "Back" and "Restart" buttons now. Only a decent little arrow indicates the hidden menu. By default, the bar is displayed as usual but can be closed. I made the state permanent. So you don't have to hide it every time.

Some modes do have an additional sidebar now that contains settings dedicated to the typing mode. The sidebar is hidden on the screen's left side and can be accessed via the small arrow icon. Those settings are only tracked for the current session and not saved permanently.

[h1]Typing Content[/h1]

The phrases typing mode got more sentences to practice in English and German. Around 55 or so in each language. I hope this lead to a less repetitive typing experience. In addition to that, you can always drop any text you like to write into the custom code feature in the Coding mode. It does not need to be source code. Any text will do.

notes.title: Typed'82 Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

I hope you're doing all well. Thanks so much again for playing and supporting Typed'82. I'm really happy about the feedback and progress over the last weeks. So, the new update is out on the beta channel and should arrive on the stable channel soonish.

[b]Anti Aliasing[/b], a new option in the settings screen. You can change it to your likes. It should help with the GPU load on high resolutions. The default setting is currently at 4xAA.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/a7507ff3511affe94ef85a8f97da131fff27ff63.png[/img]

[b]Flawless Achievments[/b]
There is a bug that the flawless achievements are triggered properly but not acknowledged by Steam. A typo on my side caused this. Version 1.0.5 addresses this issue and will scan through your save game and should trigger the achievement synchronisation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/2e2a2a25818b405df0b29a24834a7b173489703e.png[/img]

If you want to test the update with the beta channel, please do a quick savegame backup. You can find the files in "[i]%homepath%\AppData\LocalLow\Beardman Studios\Typed 82[/i]".

That's it for the update!

If you have trouble or want to know more. Please check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1525970/discussions/0/3113645835782857905/]Steam community page[/url] or leave me a message at [url=https://beardman-studios.com/]beardman-studios.com[/url]

Thanks so much everyone, enjoy the game and stay safe! <3

notes.title: Typed'82 Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

I hope you're doing all well. Thanks so much for playing and supporting Typed'82 in the last weeks. I've created an update for the game and want to share some details of the update with you.

[b]Rain[/b], a subtle shader applied to the background that hopefully gives some feeling of rain crawling down the window. It can be quite present in bright background colours but very subtle for dark ones. It has been in the works for a while now, and I hope you like it. Just visit the background colour menu from the settings screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/4e15ffd67de71132df2b68da5d83b4343bd219cb.png[/img]

[b]OldSchoolMode[/b], a quite changing shader that will introduce some visual downgrade to the game. The fonts and other elements will look very low res. This mode is actually just an update since it was available in previous versions too. It's still not finished but you can try this mode at the moment via the command screen (F2) and type OldSchoolMode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39797793/c02594d0ac38f16d1fb3d99dd2d57269e9b96ef4.png[/img]

[b]Font update[/b], I've updated the fonts to include some more characters than previously available. However, that still does not include all languages in the world.

[b]WPM fix[/b], the calculation in the Words mode had an issue counting space keystrokes properly. That has been fixed and it will increase your WPM score in that mode.

Shortcut fix, the shortcuts to restart and end a Words session did not work properly and required a fix. Since the game is supposed to be played with a keyboard only. :)

That's it for the update!

If you have trouble or want to know more. Please check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1525970/discussions/0/3113645835782857905/]Steam community page[/url] or leave me a message at [url=https://beardman-studios.com/]beardman-studios.com[/url]

Thanks so much everyone, enjoy the game and stay safe! <3
